meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把想法或现成网页做成能点击跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在会议或路演上展示一份能交互跳转、自带备注的演示稿。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable, branching slide deck with speaker notes from an idea or page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need an interactive deck that branches and shows speaker notes.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范制作幻灯片组:带离散幻灯片、片段揭示、分支、热点导航和演讲者备注的可运行演示文稿,也能把现有页面转成幻灯片组。产出是可导航的 deck,不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、演示文稿、pitch deck,或要求把现有页面转成 deck 时触发;若是从相邻说法触发的,Claude 会先问你一句是否要做 HyperFrames 幻灯片再动手。

say.note: 生成可导航 deck,用 present 播放

say.text: 把这个页面转成幻灯片,保留原来的视觉和动效
say.note: 按源页面保真规则转换

say.text: 在第 3 张幻灯片加个热点,点开跳到市场测算分支

howto.what_en: Lets Claude author HyperFrames slideshows: runnable decks with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspots and presenter notes; it can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation or pitch deck, or to convert a page into a deck. For adjacent requests Claude asks a short yes/no confirmation before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn this into a HyperFrames slideshow with speaker notes
say_en.note: Builds a navigable deck you play with hyperframes present.

say_en.text: Convert this page into a slideshow, keeping its visuals and motion
say_en.note: Ports the page under source-fidelity rules.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 that jumps to the market-sizing branch
say_en.note: Creates a branch sequence plus hotspot navigation.
